title: Acceptance probability of the sign BLR tester
statement: For any $n\ge 0$ and any function $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$, the acceptance probability of the tester that samples independent uniform $x,y\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, queries $f$ at the sign encodings of $x$, $y$, and $x+y$, and accepts when the first two answers multiply to the third, equals the BLR acceptance probability of the function $g:\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\mathbb{F}_2$ obtained by transporting $f$ through the coordinatewise sign encoding.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the $n$-dimensional sign cube to the signs
